text:
maya_eng: Quick heads up — vendor (Tom) posted new lead times for the H100 tranche. Sea 45d, air 6d. They want to allocate fewer air slots than we expected and propose a mixed plan: partial air expedite + RMA for DOAs + loaner pool. Need decision on credit vs air top-up for EU edge pools.

tom_vendor: FYI from our side — we can do air for up to 20 units at +$10k/unit, or loaner pool (up to 30 units) at $200/day/unit until swap. For DOA coverage we propose 30% credit on the affected shipment and a depot repair SLA (7 business days). We can split AWBs by region.

raj_procure: Numbers please — what's the total delta if we air 10 vs 20 to EU? Also what's credit mechanics (timing + invoice offset)?

tom_vendor: Air 10 -> +$100k. Air 20 -> +$200k. Credit: vendor issues credit memo within 10 business days after photo & serial evidence, applied to next invoice; if we need cash refund that's escalated and takes ~30 days. Brokerage/insurance extra unless waived.

elaine_ops: Question: Depot capacity in FRA/AMS for receiving and serial reconciliation? If we do partial air, can we get swap labels and depot slots within 48h of arrival? Ops needs RMA labels + manifest format. Also customs HS code confirmation — air vs sea varies.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-VEND-4521 — "EU air top-up + RMA label flow" assigned to elaine_ops. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/INF-VEND-4521 (auto-generated).

maya_eng: My preference: minimize cash burn — prefer credit + loaners for bulk, but approve air for critical EU pools up to 10 units. If vendor can waive brokerage fees and provide 48h serial list turnaround, we do air 10 and credit the rest. 

tom_vendor: We can waive brokerage for this batch if you sign PO amendment today. RMA labels: yes we can pre-generate. Need serial CSV within 48h of pickup to bind AWBs. Sample RMA manifest format below:

```
serial,model,site,preferred_depot,claimed_issue
H100-ABC123, H100, fra-edge-01, FRA-DEPOT-3, doa
H100-ABC124, H100, fra-edge-02, FRA-DEPOT-3, doa
```

raj_procure: OK lock: air 10 -> vendor to send PO amendment and waiver. Rest of allocation: credit + loaner pool until replacements ship. Please confirm loaner pickup/drop policy and daily cap.

elaine_ops: Noted. Ops will prepare depot slots for FRA-DEPOT-3 and AMS-POOL-1 and pre-authorize swap labels. We'll need photo evidence on receipt and a short QC checklist.

tom_vendor: Will send PO amendment and waiver PDF by EOD. AWB splits: EU-air (10 units) -> AWB: EU-AT-75819, rest sea LCL -> AWB: SEA-LCL-99822. We will upload photos to the RMA portal and provide tracking.

maya_eng: :thumbsup: Please also include insurance value on AWB and confirm carrier contact. Ops — once ticket INF-VEND-4521 has depot manifest and serial CSV, please tag me and raj.

ops-bot: Updated INF-VEND-4521: depot slots reserved FRA-DEPOT-3 (up to 12 swaps) and AMS-POOL-1 (loaners up to 30). ETA windows set for air arrival: 1761420000 - 1761423600.

raj_procure: I'll review PO amendment when it arrives. If vendor delays waiver or amendment, fallback is credit + extend loaner window.

elaine_ops: One more ask — vendor please confirm DOA detection window (how long after receipt we can claim DOA). We need at least 7 days.

tom_vendor: DOA window: 14 calendar days from receipt for full credit eligibility. After 14 days, standard RMA terms apply. We'll include that clause in the amendment.

maya_eng: Great. Action items: 1) Tom send PO amendment + waiver + AWB details (tom_vendor) 2) Ops prepare serial CSV + depot manifest (elaine_ops) 3) Procure sign amendment and confirm payment terms (raj_procure). I'll monitor ticket INF-VEND-4521.

ellaine_ops: will do (typo fix)
